name: offline_log
description: Serialisasi & idempotensi Offline_Log_Queue portabel (C++17, tanpa dependensi hardware). Port dari src/services/offlineLog.js: serialize/parse JSONL (Property 8), pruneAcked ber-ACK (Property 9, Req 6.3), dedupeByKey, dan model counter idempotency monotonik (next/peekNext; persistensi LittleFS = Task 24).
